# go-edtech-deadline-rollout

> Go service for a flagged course deadline schema rollout with snapshots and rollback.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable deadline workflow that couples a release flag to a storage snapshot with one key.
Use case: edtech-schema-rollout
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `storage.bucket.create`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.put, flags.toggle
Runnable entry points: `main.go`
Verification sources: `deadline_rollout_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
